title: Design System: Capabilio Landing (Daybreak plus OS)

display.purpose: Hero headline only; light first line over a bold second line.

body.purpose: Lead and running copy in Geist.

label.purpose: Flag labels, state captions, table heads.

data.purpose: JetBrains Mono for numbers, stream and ledger lines, key hints and the Sample tag only.

shadows.name: window
shadows.purpose: Product windows, the hero skill card and the command palette.

shadows.name: glass-dock
shadows.value: backdrop-filter: blur(24px); background rgba(255,255,255,.15); border 1px rgba(255,255,255,.25)
shadows.purpose: Dock only; depth through translucency, not shadow.

motion.name: ease-out-soft
motion.purpose: Hero rise, skill card swap, path accordion, scroll reveal and ledger counter.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: 28px lift, blur 8-10px, 0.8s; 70ms stagger in groups of four
motion.purpose: Hero entrance and below-fold [data-rise] reveal (pure CSS scroll-driven animation, view() timeline); content stays visible without JS or when unsupported.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Two evidence marquees; pause on hover; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: scan-line
motion.purpose: Peach band crossing the hero terrain; hidden under reduced motion.

motion.name: ridge-parallax
motion.value: far layers offset by scrollY (capped at 1000)
motion.purpose: Hero ridgeline depth; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: dock-advance
motion.purpose: OS desktop auto-advance bar; paused on hold; full under reduced motion.

motion.name: hero-cycle
motion.purpose: Skill flag auto-cycle; pauses on pointer over terrain; off under reduced motion.

narrative.northStar: Daybreak, running as an operating system
narrative.overview:
Skills are terrain. Evidence raises the ground; "not assessed" stays flat. The page opens on a pale periwinkle sky falling to apricot and brand orange, with a canvas ridgeline in atmospheric perspective (far rose to near night-indigo). The same ridgeline returns in three moods: day (hero), night (ecosystem, OS desktop wallpaper, ledger), dawn (close). Between them sit paper (calm reading ground), crisp white product windows (proof), and drenched night sections that carry the OS metaphor.

The OS metaphor is literal and structural: an orbiting ecosystem map around a Skill Passport core, a desktop with a glass dock of eight apps, a live proof stream, a playable rating ledger, and a Cmd/Ctrl+K command palette. Orange is the verb (action and the single emphasis colour); indigo is evidence (what is read or measured). Type is ink-navy on warm-white paper, white on night. The voice is confident and plain. Headline: "Resumes tell. Proof wins." Demonstration data is always labelled Sample; quotes and figures are real and link to their source.
keyCharacteristics: One living ridgeline illustration at three moods, with scan line and scroll parallax in the hero.
Night OS sections: orbit map, desktop plus glass dock, proof stream, ledger, command palette.
White app windows (title bar plus "Sample data" tag) as the unit of proof.
Big Bricolage display type; hero headline is light over bold on two lines.
Pill actions, 16px windows, 24px stages; four path cards that expand as an accordion.
Content rises on scroll (blur, lift, 28px) and the manifesto fills word by word.
Status never rests on colour alone: five distinct glyph shapes.

rules.name: The Orange Is Action Rule
rules.body: Orange marks what to do next (buttons, progress, the selected node) and, sparingly, the one number or quote mark a section wants read first. It never encodes status or state.

rules.name: The Ink On Orange Rule
rules.body: Text on orange is Ink Navy. White on orange fails the contrast the build holds.

rules.name: The Evidence Is Indigo Rule
rules.body: Indigo means "this is read or measured". Do not use it for decoration.

rules.name: The Night Is Where The System Runs Rule
rules.body: Dark Night sections hold the live, interactive OS pieces (orbit, dock, stream, ledger); light sections hold reading and claims.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only where a number, a log line, a key hint or a "Sample" status is shown.

rules.name: The Balanced Headline Rule
rules.body: Every display and headline sets `text-wrap: balance`.

rules.name: The Windows Lift Rule
rules.body: Only product windows, the palette, and map flags carry a shadow. Section cards, tables and chips use a hairline border.

rules.name: The Glass Is The Dock Rule
rules.body: Blur-and-translucency belongs to the dock and the sticky nav; it is not a card style.

dos: **Do** keep orange for the next action (and rare one-figure emphasis) and indigo for evidence.
**Do** put Ink text on orange and Paper or white text on night.
**Do** label every demonstration surface "Sample data" or "Sample profile".
**Do** pair every status color with its glyph shape and a text label.
**Do** link every external quote and figure to its real source.
**Do** show the ridgeline in one of its moods (day, night, dawn) when a section needs scale.
**Do** keep interactive OS pieces on Night and reading on Paper.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion` and keep `[data-rise]` content visible without JS.
**Do** set display and headline text with balanced wrapping.
donts: **Don't** use these tokens or this shell in the dashboard, org workspace or roadmap.
**Don't** invent customers, counts, testimonials or compliance badges.
**Don't** put a shadow on ordinary cards, tables or chips.
**Don't** use JetBrains Mono for prose or headings.
**Don't** use blur-and-translucency as a general card style.
